trust.reason: The residual ANN has strong discrimination and after-cost edge, but feature-family certainty, fold stability, post-selection bias, and point-in-time universe controls still block promotion.

findings.finding: The residual ANN is economically promising but unstable by time period.
findings.evidence: The five-sleeve replay averaged +0.100% daily after 10 bps, while one of four temporal splits was negative for both seeds.
findings.next_step: Freeze the lean-volatility and trend-down policies now and confirm them only on future unseen dates.

findings.finding: Volatility is the clearest predictive feature family.
findings.evidence: The lean volatility ANN reached 0.696 AUC and beat logistic on return, AUC, and rank IC with positive weekly-block lower bounds.
findings.next_step: Retain volatility as the leading candidate while requiring fresh economic confirmation against momentum and the full ANN.

findings.finding: Moving to cash in trend-down regimes improved the point estimate, not the confidence bound.
findings.evidence: The gated policy raised mean daily residual return to +0.119%, but its paired 95% interval still crossed zero.
findings.next_step: Treat the gate as a frozen research candidate rather than a deployable rule.

findings.finding: Champions are still research-only or watch-tier.
findings.evidence: Best champion ROC AUC is 0.5344; worst champion Brier skill is -0.0318.
findings.next_step: Improve calibration and walk-forward stability before trusting high-probability ranks.

findings.evidence: Train/test order, embargo, walk-forward, and metric-spike checks are ok.
findings.next_step: Add feature availability timestamps next, because compact checks do not prove every feature is timestamp-safe.

findings.finding: Some latest model outputs are high-confidence enough to require calibration checks.
findings.next_step: Use calibration curves before treating high-confidence ranks as stronger signals.

model_actions.recommended_change: Freeze the lean volatility ANN and trend-down cash rule, then evaluate them on newly arriving dates without retuning.
model_actions.evidence: Both candidates improved point estimates, but neither cleared every pre-specified uncertainty gate against all relevant controls.
model_actions.acceptance_test: Return, AUC, and rank-IC deltas retain positive lower bounds on future unseen dates, with no negative temporal split after costs.

model_actions.recommended_change: Add dated universe membership, delisting outcomes, and missing-return disposition before any promotion decision.
model_actions.evidence: Temporal leakage checks passed, but point-in-time universe ownership remains unverified and maximum missing portfolio weight reached 9.2%.
model_actions.acceptance_test: Every ticker-date has a verified eligibility state and delisting-safe return path.

model_actions.recommended_change: Calibrate the frozen candidate inside training folds only and continue to cap decision confidence.
model_actions.evidence: Residual ranking improved, but full probability calibration has not passed a promotion gate.
model_actions.acceptance_test: Out-of-sample Brier skill is non-negative and reliability buckets track observed outcomes.

model_actions.recommended_change: Keep all candidate decisions in paper mode while future unseen outcomes accumulate.
model_actions.evidence: The policy rules are post-selection hypotheses and no family passed all confirmation tests.
model_actions.acceptance_test: Frozen candidates pass the future confirmation protocol without rule changes.
